newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Jan 14.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on January 14:

WASHINGTON - The Clinton administration proposed that the federal government take responsibility for billions of dollars of District of Columbia programmes in exchange for eliminating the $660 million annual federal payment to the city.
WASHINGTON - New revelations in the ethics case of House Speaker Newt Gingrich cast doubt on the speaker's defence that he did not intentionally mislead the House ethics committee.
WASHINGTON - The Florida couple that taped House Speaker Newt Gingrich's cellular phone call with top lieutenants said they considered the recording "part of history."
WASHINGTON - The Supreme Court considered whether President Bill Clinton can be forced to stand trial on sexual harassment charges brought by Paula Corbin Jones.
WASHINGTON - President Bill Clinton honored seven African American servicemen with the nation's highest award for valour for their heroic acts during World War Two.
WASHINGTON - The Food and Drug Administration said the popular antihistamine Seldane is unsafe and should be taken off the market.
